title: Robb Guinto confirms split from Yasser Marta, denies cheating

blocks.text: Robb Guinto became emotional as she confirmed that she and Yasser Marta have broken up while denying that she was unfaithful to the actor. Guinto addressed their breakup in a Facebook Live video on Monday, Oct. 6, saying she decided to speak out after feeling that her name and her family’s reputation were being affected by the issues surrounding their relationship. “Hindi ko alam kung bakit ako magsasalita. Hindi para linisin ko ‘yung sarili ko or kung anuman. Nakita ko kasi nasisira ‘yung pangalan ko,” she said. “Ang sakit lang kasi hindi lang ako ang naaapektuhan kundi pati yung mga magulang […]...
